Ava (Marketing): Quick workshop: finalize hero copy + inbound routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need 3 H1s per page, CTAs, and where to surface webinar.
Noah (Product): Keep it developer-forward. One H1 should call out predictable latency/cost but avoid exact numbers.
Ivy (Design): I'll make three hero comps (feature, benefit, trust) with mobile-first spacing. Add badge cluster for Private: SOC2, KMS.
Ava (Marketing): HOSTED H1s:
1) "Hosted inference API for production-grade LLMs"
2) "Low-latency, scalable text generation  no infra required"
3) "Ship LLM features fast with a hosted inference API"
Sam (Growth): A/B test 1 vs 2. CTA matrix: primary "Start building  free credits" (self-serve), secondary "See benchmarks" (anchor). Add a slim webinar strip: "Webinar: Building LLM features with Redwood  May 18" CTA "Register".
Noah (Product): Microline under hosted hero: "Stream responses, function calling, and model routing with predictable pricing."
Ava (Marketing): DEDICATED H1s:
1) "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
2) "Dedicated inference with SLA-backed performance"
3) "Commit capacity, control latency and unit cost"
Sam (Growth): Dedicated CTA split: "Request capacity" (AE) vs "Estimate throughput" (self-serve). We'll gate AE CTAs by company size >50 or intent signals.
Ravi (Eng): AE form needs qps, seq length, model family. We'll prefill model when route param is present. Events: `site_hero_cta` with product & variant props.
Ava (Marketing): PRIVATE H1s:
1) "Private deployment: VPC or on-prem inference"
2) "Keep inference where your data lives  enterprise-grade controls"
3) "Air-gapped, auditable serving for regulated workloads"
Noah (Product): Use 2 on product pages, 3 on industry pages. CTA: "Contact sales" or "Schedule compliance review". Add small badges under hero.
Ivy (Design): I'll drop badge cluster and a small compliance link under hero.
Sam (Growth): HubSpot routing: AE leads go to pipeline `site-hero-ae`, tags [product:dedicated|private], source=website, campaign=hero-launch-2026. Self-serve signups go to free-credits funnel.
Ava (Marketing): Measurement plan: Hosted A/B for 10 days, track signup rate, webinar CTR, bounce. Dedicated/Private: track AE form submits and MQL->SQL conversion.
ClaimBot: Reminder: avoid absolute claims (no exact speedups) unless benchmarked. Use "representative workloads" language.
Noah (Product): I'll share approved benchmark phrasing and one-liners by EOD.
Ravi (Eng): We'll implement routing hooks and the `website_hero_cta_click` event within 48h. Fallback: form emails to sales@redwood.ai if HubSpot is down.
Ava (Marketing): Action items: finalize hero copy (Ava), Figma comps (Ivy), HubSpot flows (Sam), infra hooks (Ravi), benchmark page (Noah). Deadline: draft Wed, publish next Tue. Any blockers?
All: No blockers. Ava: will collate and circulate doc + Figma link when Ivy posts.
